house_style: Naturalistic landscape painting for a high school ecology simulator: realistic plants and land, soft natural light, muted calm colors, a wide empty view with open ground in the foreground, deserted and still. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no frame.
style: Wide backdrops under a dark stage; small animal icons are drawn on top of the open foreground, so the foreground stays plain and uncluttered.

assets.name: cc-forest-edge
assets.prompt: A northern forest edge meeting a grassy clearing in late summer: dark spruce, fir and birch trees along the back, shrubs and young saplings at the forest margin, and a wide open stretch of short grass and low browse across the foreground, empty and still.

assets.name: cc-tundra-island
assets.prompt: A treeless subarctic island tundra under an overcast sky: low rolling green-brown hills, pale gray-green lichen mats and short grass and sedge, a band of gray sea at the horizon, and a wide open stretch of flat tundra across the foreground, empty and still.
